introPt: A traveller gets teased and handles it right.
cenario: At a table with new acquaintances.

dialogo.es: Ma tu sei scemo, eh! Guarda che roba.
dialogo.pt: You're an idiot, you know! Look at that.
dialogo.tts: Ma tu sei scemo, eh! Guarda che roba.

dialogo.es: Il mio italiano è un disastro, lo so.
dialogo.pt: My Italian is a disaster, I know.
dialogo.tts: Il mio italiano è un disastro, lo so.

dialogo.es: Ma no, ma va! Parli benissimo, complimenti.
dialogo.pt: Not at all, come on! You speak really well, well done.
dialogo.tts: Ma no, ma va! Parli benissimo, complimenti.

dialogo.es: Certo, come no. E io sono il Papa.
dialogo.pt: Sure, of course. And I'm the Pope.
dialogo.tts: Certo, come no. E io sono il Papa.

opcoes: Affectionate mockery between people with a relationship
perguntas.explica: The licence is earned, not shared with the room.

perguntas.pergunta: Can you repeat a regional joke as a foreigner?
opcoes: Yes, it shows you fit in
No - it reads as a foreigner judging a family argument
perguntas.explica: North and south have been teasing each other for 150 years.
Your Italian, your appetite, your cappuccino at four.
The marker is tone, not words.

perguntas.pergunta: You missed the joke. Best move?
opcoes: Say ah, mi prendi in giro, or ask
perguntas.explica: The polite laugh gives you away anyway.
